title: LLM-Enhanced Multimodal House Price Prediction using Structured, Textual, and Visual Features
abstract: arXiv:2611.01615v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate house price prediction is essential for real estate buyers, sellers, agents, and financial institutions. Traditional methods rely primarily on structured data, e.g., number of bedrooms, bathrooms, parkings, but they overlook rich contextual information embedded in textual descriptions and property photos. Previous deep learning approaches for house price prediction have fused multimodal data but they fall short to extract structured spatio-temporal and contextual features from texts and semantic visual information from images. In this paper, we introduce a novel multimodal framework that addresses these limitations by systematically integrating structured attributes, textual descriptions, and visual images of properties to achieve higher prediction accuracy while maintaining interpretability. translated_title: 基于结构化、文本和视觉特征的LLM增强多模态房价预测
translated_abstract: 准确的房价预测对房地产买家、卖家、中介机构和金融机构至关重要。传统方法主要依赖结构化数据，例如卧室数量、浴室数量、停车位数量等，但忽视了文本描述和房产照片中蕴含的丰富上下文信息。以往用于房价预测的深度学习方法虽然融合了多模态数据，但无法从文本中提取结构化的时空和上下文特征，也无法从图像中提取语义视觉信息。本文提出了一种新颖的多模态框架，通过系统地整合房产的结构化属性、文本描述和视觉图像来解决上述局限性，在保持可解释性的同时实现更高的预测精度。我们使用大语言模型从文本中提取特定领域的时空和上下文特征，并使用无监督视觉语言模型（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个融合结构化数据、文本描述和图像的大语言模型增强多模态房价预测框架，利用LLM从文本中提取特定领域的时空和上下文特征，在保持可解释性的同时显著提升预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-enhanced multimodal framework for house price prediction that systematically integrates structured, textual, and visual features, leveraging large language models to extract domain-specific spatio-temporal and contextual features from text, achieving higher prediction accuracy while maintaining interpretability.
